kinematograficheskiy-realizm--ref-01.author: Pavel Diordits
kinematograficheskiy-realizm--ref-01.license_basis: собственная генерация владельца репозитория; проект не считает сгенерированные изображения объектом исключительных прав (RIGHTS.md)
kinematograficheskiy-realizm--ref-01.why: тёмный отсек: одна тёплая лампа режет фигуру из черноты, холодный иллюминатор
kinematograficheskiy-realizm--ref-01.style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge
kinematograficheskiy-realizm--ref-01.palette_en: Low key: roughly three quarters of the frame sits in deep shadow and near-black is the largest area in the picture; light claims only what its sources directly reach. Colour comes from those sources — warm amber and sodium — against shadow that stays a cold steel-blue rather than turning brown.

maslo-epika--ref-01.why: эпический масштаб: фигура мелко, воздух между планами
maslo-epika--ref-01.style_notes_en: thick impasto oil with glazed transparent darks, a great open expanse above the figures — sky, vault or shaft, whatever the place actually offers — taking much of the frame, layered atmospheric perspective with visible air between planes, figures small against the scale of the place, romantic painting logic rather than concept art, visible canvas weave
maslo-epika--ref-01.palette_en: Middle key: the picture reads at middle brightness and is not a dark painting — deep shadow is held to about a fifth of the frame and there is lit air between the planes. Warm earth near at hand — ochre, umber, brick — against a distance that stays genuinely blue and keeps its colour instead of going black.
